observations: Photo 0 shows a V6 engine with a black intake manifold, various hoses, and a throttle body. The engine block appears dirty and used, with visible oil stains and wear.
Photo 1 shows the front of the engine with the cylinder head removed, exposing the intake ports and valve cover. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of use and rust.

Photo 2 shows the front of the engine with the timing cover and pulleys visible. A barcode sticker is present on a black plastic component, but the text is unreadable. The engine appears to be disassembled and in a workshop environment.
All photos show a large V6 engine consistent with Toyota/Lexus 2GR-FE or similar variants.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on the engine block or components.
